fruits.extendedStory: Legend has it that the Holy Chalice kept here may be the cup Jesus used at the Last Supper. Above the altar, angels hid for centuries. Two painters had signed on to paint them in the vault. Later, a Baroque dome built about 80 centimetres below covered them up. In June 2004, restorers looked through a small hole and saw an angel playing a musical instrument.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Legende nach könnte der Heilige Kelch, der hier aufbewahrt wird, der Becher sein, den Jesus beim Letzten Abendmahl benutzte. Über dem Altar versteckten sich jahrhundertelang Engel. Zwei Maler hatten sich verpflichtet, sie ins Gewölbe zu malen. Später verdeckte sie eine Barockkuppel, gebaut rund 80 Zentimeter darunter. Im Juni 2004 blickten Restauratoren durch ein kleines Loch und sahen einen Engel, der ein Instrument spielte.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Legend has it that the Holy Chalice kept here may be the cup Jesus used at the Last Supper. Above the altar, angels hid for centuries. Two painters had signed on to paint them in the vault. Later, a Baroque dome built about 80 centimetres below covered them up. In June 2004, restorers looked through a small hole and saw an angel playing a musical instrument.

localizedStory.de: Jeden Donnerstagmittag tagen acht Bauern in schwarzen Kitteln am Apostelportal. Sie schlichten Streit um Bewässerungswasser, bei jedem Wetter.
localizedStory.en: Every Thursday at noon, eight farmers in black smocks meet at the Door of the Apostles. They settle quarrels over irrigation water, rain or shine.

fruits.name: Catedral de València
fruits.story: Every Thursday at noon, eight farmers in black smocks meet at the Door of the Apostles. They settle quarrels over irrigation water, rain or shine.

fruits.extendedStory: The story goes that three pilgrims came to the Hospital of the Innocents. They were shut in a small chapel to carve an image of the Virgin. By the fourth day they had vanished, leaving just the statue. People said the angels had made it. Every March, during the Fallas, a team climbs a huge copy of her set up in the square outside. They fix the flowers that thousands of festival members bring, until her cloak is a tapestry of colour.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Sage nach kamen drei Pilger ins Hospital der Unschuldigen. Man schloss sie in eine kleine Kapelle, damit sie ein Bild der Jungfrau schnitzten. Am vierten Tag waren sie verschwunden, nur die Figur war noch da. Die Leute sagten, Engel hätten sie gemacht. Jedes Jahr im März, zu den Fallas, klettert ein Team auf eine riesige Nachbildung der Jungfrau auf dem Platz davor. Es steckt die Blumen fest, die Tausende Festmitglieder bringen, bis ihr Mantel ein bunter Blumenteppich ist.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The story goes that three pilgrims came to the Hospital of the Innocents. They were shut in a small chapel to carve an image of the Virgin. By the fourth day they had vanished, leaving just the statue. People said the angels had made it. Every March, during the Fallas, a team climbs a huge copy of her set up in the square outside. They fix the flowers that thousands of festival members bring, until her cloak is a tapestry of colour.

localizedStory.de: Ihr Spitzname ist la Geperudeta, die kleine Bucklige: So nennen die Valencianer liebevoll die leicht gebeugte Marienfigur hier drinnen.
localizedStory.en: Valencians' nickname for the Virgin inside is la Geperudeta, the little hunchback, because her statue stands slightly stooped.

fruits.name: Basílica de la Mare de Déu dels Desemparats
fruits.story: Valencians' nickname for the Virgin inside is la Geperudeta, the little hunchback, because her statue stands slightly stooped.

fruits.extendedStory: The square tower has three floors. A chapel sits at the bottom, and the two floors above were a prison for merchants who had gone bankrupt. Next door, the Consolat del Mar was the seat of the first maritime trade court in Spain. Pere Compte began the work in 1483, and the Hall of Columns went up first. In 1996 the silk exchange became a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der quadratische Turm hat drei Stockwerke. Unten liegt eine Kapelle, und die zwei Etagen darüber waren ein Gefängnis für Kaufleute, die bankrott gegangen waren. Nebenan saß im Consolat del Mar das erste Seehandelsgericht Spaniens. Pere Compte begann 1483 mit dem Bau, und die Säulenhalle entstand zuerst. Seit 1996 ist die Seidenbörse UNESCO-Welterbe.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The square tower has three floors. A chapel sits at the bottom, and the two floors above were a prison for merchants who had gone bankrupt. Next door, the Consolat del Mar was the seat of the first maritime trade court in Spain. Pere Compte began the work in 1483, and the Hall of Columns went up first. In 1996 the silk exchange became a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

localizedStory.de: Tritt in die Säulenhalle: Acht Steinsäulen winden sich wie Spiralen nach oben, über dem Boden, auf dem Kaufleute ihre Geschäfte abschlossen.
localizedStory.en: Step into the Hall of Columns: eight stone columns twist up like spirals over the floor where merchants struck their deals.

fruits.name: Llotja de la Seda
fruits.story: Step into the Hall of Columns: eight stone columns twist up like spirals over the floor where merchants struck their deals.

fruits.extendedStory: A second tale lives in the basement. At closing time, when the noise died down, roaring sounds came up from below. Nobody dared look, so the story goes that a crocodile lived down there. Some even claimed to have seen it. Up top, the parrot shares the roof with a fish weathervane. The central dome beneath them is iron, glass and ceramic, 30 metres high, over a hall designed for 959 stalls.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Eine zweite Geschichte wohnt im Keller. Wenn nach Marktschluss der Lärm verklang, drang von unten ein Brüllen herauf. Niemand traute sich nachzusehen. Also erzählt man, dort unten lebe ein Krokodil. Manche wollen es sogar gesehen haben. Oben teilt sich der Papagei das Dach mit einem Fisch als Wetterfahne. Die Mittelkuppel darunter ist aus Eisen, Glas und Keramik, 30 Meter hoch, über einer Halle für 959 Marktstände.
localizedExtendedStory.en: A second tale lives in the basement. At closing time, when the noise died down, roaring sounds came up from below. Nobody dared look, so the story goes that a crocodile lived down there. Some even claimed to have seen it. Up top, the parrot shares the roof with a fish weathervane. The central dome beneath them is iron, glass and ceramic, 30 metres high, over a hall designed for 959 stalls.

localizedStory.de: Schau hoch zur Kuppel. Die Papageien-Wetterfahne heißt Cotorra del Mercat. Der Sage nach plauderte sie mit einem Spatz über alles, was in der Stadt geschah.
localizedStory.en: Look up. The parrot weathervane is the Cotorra del Mercat, and legend says she chatted with a sparrow about everything in the city.

fruits.name: Mercat Central
fruits.story: Look up. The parrot weathervane is the Cotorra del Mercat, and legend says she chatted with a sparrow about everything in the city.

fruits.extendedStory: Every last Sunday of February, the Fallera Mayor of València calls everyone to the Fallas festival from these towers. That ceremony is the Crida. The towers take their name from the serranos, travellers who came in here on the main road from Aragon. During the Spanish Civil War, lorries brought treasures from Madrid's Prado Museum here to keep them safe. Among them were paintings by Goya, Velázquez and Titian.

localizedExtendedStory.de: An jedem letzten Sonntag im Februar ruft die Fallera Mayor von València von diesen Türmen alle zum Fallas-Fest. Diese Zeremonie heißt Crida. Ihren Namen haben die Türme von den Serranos, Reisenden, die auf der Hauptstraße aus Aragón hier hereinkamen. Im Spanischen Bürgerkrieg brachten Lastwagen Schätze aus dem Prado in Madrid hierher, um sie in Sicherheit zu bringen. Darunter waren Gemälde von Goya, Velázquez und Tizian.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Every last Sunday of February, the Fallera Mayor of València calls everyone to the Fallas festival from these towers. That ceremony is the Crida. The towers take their name from the serranos, travellers who came in here on the main road from Aragon. During the Spanish Civil War, lorries brought treasures from Madrid's Prado Museum here to keep them safe. Among them were paintings by Goya, Velázquez and Titian.

localizedStory.de: Von außen sehen sie aus wie zwei Türme, in die niemand hineinkommt. Geh nach hinten herum: Dort stehen sie offen, mit gotischen Räumen unter Spitzbögen.
localizedStory.en: From outside, these look like two towers nobody could get into. Walk round the back: they stand open, with Gothic rooms under pointed arches.

fruits.name: Torres dels Serrans
fruits.story: From outside, these look like two towers nobody could get into. Walk round the back: they stand open, with Gothic rooms under pointed arches.

fruits.extendedStory: The Dukes of Gandia, part of the Borja family, lived here from 1485. Their family gave the world Calixtus III and Alexander VI, the two Spanish popes, both from Valencia. After the Borjas, other noble families owned the palace, and it was even a silk factory. Look for the Gothic parts: the entrance portal and the gallery of windows on the top floor. Inside, coffered ceilings survive, and the courtyard has Renaissance columns between round arches.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Die Herzöge von Gandia, ein Zweig der Familie Borja, wohnten hier ab 1485. Aus ihrer Familie kamen Calixtus III. und Alexander VI., die beiden spanischen Päpste, beide aus Valencia. Nach den Borja gehörte der Palast anderen Adelsfamilien, und er war sogar eine Seidenfabrik. Achte auf die gotischen Teile: das Eingangsportal und die Fensterreihe im obersten Stock. Drinnen sind Kassettendecken erhalten, und im Innenhof stehen Renaissance-Säulen zwischen Rundbögen.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The Dukes of Gandia, part of the Borja family, lived here from 1485. Their family gave the world Calixtus III and Alexander VI, the two Spanish popes, both from Valencia. After the Borjas, other noble families owned the palace, and it was even a silk factory. Look for the Gothic parts: the entrance portal and the gallery of windows on the top floor. Inside, coffered ceilings survive, and the courtyard has Renaissance columns between round arches.

localizedStory.de: Das Regionalparlament von Valencia macht seine Gesetze in einem gotischen Palast, der einst den Borja gehörte, einer Familie, die zwei Päpste hervorbrachte.
localizedStory.en: The Valencian region's parliament makes its laws inside a Gothic palace. It once belonged to the Borjas, a family that gave the world two popes.

fruits.name: Corts Valencianes
fruits.story: The Valencian region's parliament makes its laws inside a Gothic palace. It once belonged to the Borjas, a family that gave the world two popes.

fruits.extendedStory: The Ministry of Culture says the two waters are the rivers Júcar and Magro. Around 1740 the third Marquis had his plain family house redone by the engraver and painter Hipólito Rovira. The sculptor Ignacio Vergara carved Rovira's design for the doorway. The same pair made the family's gala coach, the Carriage of the Nymphs, and it still stands inside. Since 1954 the palace has held the National Ceramics Museum.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Laut Kulturministerium stehen die zwei Wasser für die Flüsse Júcar und Magro. Um 1740 ließ der dritte Marquis das schlichte Familienhaus von Hipólito Rovira umgestalten, einem Kupferstecher und Maler. Der Bildhauer Ignacio Vergara meißelte Roviras Entwurf für das Portal. Dasselbe Paar schuf auch die Prunkkutsche der Familie, die Kutsche der Nymphen. Sie steht bis heute drinnen. Seit 1954 beherbergt der Palast das Nationale Keramikmuseum.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The Ministry of Culture says the two waters are the rivers Júcar and Magro. Around 1740 the third Marquis had his plain family house redone by the engraver and painter Hipólito Rovira. The sculptor Ignacio Vergara carved Rovira's design for the doorway. The same pair made the family's gala coach, the Carriage of the Nymphs, and it still stands inside. Since 1954 the palace has held the National Ceramics Museum.

localizedStory.de: Zwei Männer aus Alabaster gießen am Portal Wasser aus Krügen. Das spielt auf den Familientitel an: Dos Aguas heißt zwei Wasser.
localizedStory.en: Two carved alabaster men on the doorway pour water from jars. It is a nod to the family's title, Dos Aguas: two waters.

fruits.name: Palau del Marqués de Dosaigües
fruits.story: Two carved alabaster men on the doorway pour water from jars. It is a nod to the family's title, Dos Aguas: two waters.

fruits.extendedStory: Gianluigi Colalucci, who led the restoration of the Sistine Chapel in Rome, called this vault the Valencian Sistine Chapel. Its frescoes cover 2,000 square metres of vaults, ribs and columns. The parish has a story too. The story goes that a miracle saved a newborn baby's life, so the church gave Saint Peter of Verona an altar. He became its second patron, beside Saint Nicholas.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Gianluigi Colalucci, der die Restaurierung der Sixtinischen Kapelle in Rom leitete, nannte dieses Gewölbe die Sixtinische Kapelle Valencias. Die Fresken bedecken 2.000 Quadratmeter Gewölbe, Rippen und Säulen. Auch die Pfarrei hat eine Geschichte. Der Überlieferung nach rettete ein Wunder einem Neugeborenen das Leben. Deshalb weihte die Kirche dem heiligen Petrus von Verona einen Altar. Er wurde neben dem heiligen Nikolaus ihr zweiter Patron.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Gianluigi Colalucci, who led the restoration of the Sistine Chapel in Rome, called this vault the Valencian Sistine Chapel. Its frescoes cover 2,000 square metres of vaults, ribs and columns. The parish has a story too. The story goes that a miracle saved a newborn baby's life, so the church gave Saint Peter of Verona an altar. He became its second patron, beside Saint Nicholas.

localizedStory.de: Such die Stirnwand: Dort sind beide Maler porträtiert. Antonio Palomino entwarf diese Fresken, gemalt hat sie aber sein Schüler Dionís Vidal.
localizedStory.en: Find the end wall: portraits of both painters are up there. Antonio Palomino designed these frescoes, but his pupil Dionís Vidal painted them.

fruits.name: Església de Sant Nicolau
fruits.story: Find the end wall: portraits of both painters are up there. Antonio Palomino designed these frescoes, but his pupil Dionís Vidal painted them.
